about: Home Depot product pages and searches recorded 2026-11-20 in the owner's Chrome from a homedepot.com tab (fetch('/p/<id>') and fetch('/s/<query>'); the page's window.__APOLLO_STATE__ parsed in the tab). Trimmed to what research reads: for pages, base-catalog-<id> with identifiers (brandName, productLabel, modelNumber, canonicalUrl, itemId), details (description, highlights, descriptiveAttributes name/value; HTML link bullets dropped), specificationGroup (specTitle, specName, specValue), bundleFlag, bundleItems; for searches, the first 12 base-searchNav-<id> entries in page order with identifiers. Query strings removed. No SerpApi. Checksums verified on transfer.

identifiers.productLabel: ONE+ 18V Cordless 2-Tool Combo Kit with 5-1/2 in. Circular Saw and Jig Saw (Tools Only)

details.description: The 18V ONE+ 2-Tool Combo Kit with the 18V 5-1/2" Circular Saw and 18V Jig Saw allows you to tackle any cut and every project. The 5-1/2" Circular Saw has the ability to make fast, clean cuts with a cut speed of 4,700 RPM. Achieve over 215 cuts per charge and get the job done without stopping. The circular saw has the ability to cut through 2-by material with 1-11/16" depth of cut and 0-50° bevel capacity. It's equipped with a spindle lock and on-board wrench storage for convenient blade changes. The Jig Saw has the ability to make fast, precise cuts and it's equipped with a variable speed dialing reaching 0-3,000 SPM. Match power to application with 4 orbital settings. Experience a 30% reduction in vibration to enhance your cut control. The tool-free blade release provides quick and easy blade changes for all t-shank blades. Best of all, it is part of the RYOBI ONE+ system where any 18V ONE+ battery works with any 18V ONE+ product. This 18V ONE+ 2-Tool Combo Kit is backed by the RYOBI 3-year manufacturer’s warranty and includes an 18V 5-1/2" Circular Saw, 18V Jig Saw, 18T Carbide Tipped Blade, (2) Hex Wrenches, Non-Marring Shoe, T-Shank Wood Cutting Blade and Operator's Manuals.

details.description: RYOBI introduces the 18V ONE+ HP Brushless 2-Tool Combo Kit. The 18V ONE+ HP Brushless 3/8 in. Extended Reach Ratchet features ONE+ HP Technology that provides up to 55 ft./lbs. of torque, while the 18V ONE+ HP Brushless 1/4 in. Extended Reach Ratchet delivers up to 40 ft-lbs. of torque. Utilize these ratchet's extended reach and slim heads to access hard to reach areas. The 4-position head makes fitting into tight spaces a breeze at any angle. Regardless of the angle you position the ratchet, your workspace will be illuminated by one of the two LED's on the front of the ratchet. The included Brushless Extended Reach Ratchets are compatible with all RYOBI 18V ONE+ Tools. Best of all, it is part of the RYOBI ONE+ System of over 300 Cordless Products that all work on the same battery platform. This 18V ONE+ HP 2-Tool Combo Kit is backed by the RYOBI 3-Year Manufacturer's Warranty and includes a Brushless 3/8 in. Extended Reach Ratchet, Brushless 1/4 in. Extended Reach Ratchet, and Operator's Manuals.

identifiers.productLabel: ONE+ 18V Lithium Starter Kit with (1) 2.0 Ah Battery, (1) 4.0 Ah Battery, and Charger

details.description: Get more out of your RYOBI ONE+ tools with extended runtime and greater versatility using the 18V ONE+ 4Ah & 2Ah Lithium Starter Kit. The high-capacity 4Ah battery delivers more runtime between charges, while the compact, lightweight 2Ah battery provides a convenient option when portability and reduced weight matter most. The batteries feature IntelliCell Electronics, a smarter power and runtime management system, that maximizes performance to keep your tools performing at their best, even during demanding use. Advanced lithium-ion cells provide dependable, fade-free power that keeps your tools operating at full power until the job is done. The COOL-CORE heat management system regulates pack temperature to keep it running cooler and maintain consistent output during use. A durable pack design with anti-vibration technology adds protection against impacts and everyday wear, whether you’re on the job or working around the house. A high-visibility LED fuel gauge clearly displays remaining runtime so you can stay productive without interruptions. Quickly charge the 2Ah battery to a ready state in as little as 50 minutes when paired with the included RYOBI ONE+ charger. Part of the RYOBI ONE+ system – any 18V ONE+ battery works with any 18V ONE+ product. This 18V ONE+ 4Ah & 2Ah Lithium Starter Kit is backed by the RYOBI 3-year manufacturer’s warranty and includes the PBP004 18V ONE+ 4Ah Lithium Battery, PBP003 18V ONE+ 2Ah Battery, and PCG002 18V ONE+ Charger.

identifiers.productLabel: ONE+18V Cordless 6-Tool Combo Kit with Batteries, and Charger & ONE+18V 4.0 Ah Lithium Battery

details.description: RYOBI introduces the 18V ONE+ 6-Tool Combo Kit with 1/2 in. Drill/Driver, 1/4 in. Impact Driver, Reciprocating Saw, 5-1/2 in. Circular Saw, Multi-Tool, LED Light, Batteries, Charger, and Bag. The Drill/Driver provides up to 515 in./lbs. of torque and features a 1/2 in. ratcheting metal chuck to match your drilling and driving needs. The Impact Driver is able to drive long deck screws or large lag screws with ease by delivering 3,400 IPM along with 1800 in./lbs. of torque controlled by a variable-speed trigger that churns out 2,700 RPM. The Reciprocating Saw delivers better productivity with up to 3,400 SPM and 60% faster cutting. The 5-1/2 in. Circular Saw has the ability to cut through 2-by material, with over 215 cuts per charge. The Multi-Tool features an adjustable speed dial giving the ability to make cuts into drywall, metal, wood, plastic, composite and other materials, along with the ability to sand the finest details. The LED Light also has 280 Lumens of light output and has a 130° pivoting head. The included Batteries and Charger are compatible with RYOBI ONE+ Tools. Best of all, this kit is part of the RYOBI ONE+ System of over 300 Cordless Products that all work on the same battery platform. Backed by the RYOBI 3-Year Manufacturer's Warranty, this Kit includes a Drill/Driver, an Impact Driver, a Circular Saw, a Reciprocating Saw, a Multi-Tool, an LED Light, a 4.0 Ah Battery, a 1.5 Ah Battery, Charger, Bag, and Operator’s Manuals.
